title: Applications
description: What your services consist of: platforms such as Insights Hub or Industrial Edge, and smaller applications. Each one can have a CIA rating (protection need).
name: Name
ownersHelp: Users and teams who may edit and rate this application: user:<name> or team:<name>
archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? It no longer counts for the protection need of its services and disappears from the list and the pickers; its rating, links and history stay.

filters.protectionHint: Applications with this level in at least one dimension

emptyState.title: No applications yet
emptyState.text: Your administrators or designers add the applications your services consist of.
emptyState.textCreate: Add the applications your services consist of, map their Steward platforms and rate their protection need.

services.title: Services
services.empty: No service consists of this application yet. Add it on the service page.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.help: Steward platforms that connect to this application. A platform belongs to one application at most. Mapping or removing a platform needs the manage right on it.
integrations.empty: No platform is mapped to this application.
integrations.removeConfirm: Remove the platform {{name}} from this application? The platform itself stays.
integrations.notVisible: A platform you may not see

documents.title: Documentation
documents.help: Living documents that apply to this application. Name the applications on the document page under Applies to.
documents.empty: No document applies to this application yet.

cia.title: CIA rating
cia.help: How much protection the application needs, per dimension, each with a justification.
cia.justificationHelp: Why this level: the damage scenarios that apply
cia.needsReratingHint: The scale changed (was “{{label}}”). It does not count until it is rated again.
cia.mapped: Mapped from “{{label}}” when the scale changed

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: The impact of damage is limited and calculable.

high.label: High
high.description: The impact of damage can be considerable.

very_high.label: Very high
very_high.description: The impact of damage can reach an existentially threatening, catastrophic level.

cia.scaleInvalid: The CIA scale is invalid – protection needs can’t be determined until an administrator saves the scale.

need.title: Protection need
need.help: Per dimension the highest rating of the service’s applications (maximum principle, BSI IT-Grundschutz). Override it with a reason, for example for a cumulation or distribution effect.
need.reasonHelp: Why the derived level does not apply, e.g. a cumulation or distribution effect
need.overrideNeedsRerating: The override needs re-rating after a scale change (was “{{label}}”).
need.noApplications: Add applications to derive the protection need.

serviceApps.title: Applications
serviceApps.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this service? The application itself stays.
serviceApps.empty: No applications yet. Add the applications this service consists of.

scope.title: Applies to
scope.help: The applications this document is about, e.g. an ICAM concept for Insights Hub. Leave it empty when it applies to the whole service.
scope.label: Applications

scale.title: CIA scale
scale.description: The levels of the CIA rating, lowest first. By default the BSI IT-Grundschutz protection needs normal, high and very high.

modes.shared: Own scale for all three dimensions

scale.readOnly: Only administrators can change the scale.
scale.lowestFirst: Lowest first: the order decides the maximum principle.
scale.label: Label
scale.mappingHelp: These levels are no longer on the scale. Map their ratings to a new level, or flag them for re-rating. No rating is deleted.
scale.invalid: Each level needs a key and a label, and every key must be unique (at least two levels).
scale.reorderTitle: Levels change their order or label
scale.reorderHelp: These levels stay, but in another order or with the label another level had: their ratings would mean something else. They are flagged for re-rating.
scale.confirmReorder: Flag the ratings of these levels for re-rating
scale.storedInvalid: The stored scale is not valid (for example from a migration package). The BSI default is in use until an administrator saves a scale.

components.title: Components
components.help: What the application consists of. Processes read them through an input of type application, e.g. all Kafka topics of the application.
components.removeConfirm: Remove the component {{name}} with its tech stack from this application?
components.name: Name
components.nameHint: As processes use it, e.g. the topic name or the image without a tag

stackEditor.help: Products from the endoflife.date list with the version in use. Entries you enter or change here win over an SBOM import.

rollup.title: Tech stack
rollup.help: All components together. End-of-life dates follow in a later version.

sbom.title: Import an SBOM into {{name}}
sbom.help: CycloneDX or SPDX in JSON, e.g. from Syft or Trivy. Steward keeps only the products endoflife.date knows (operating systems, runtimes, databases, major frameworks); libraries stay out. Entries entered by hand stay as they are.
sbom.urlHint: https, without redirects; the outbound policy applies
sbom.summary: {{format}} “{{name}}”: {{matched}} of {{total}} entries are products endoflife.date knows.
sbom.summaryNoName: {{format}}: {{matched}} of {{total}} entries are products endoflife.date knows.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.help: Entries of the credentials register that name this application under "Used by".
